# The Blackwell Dilemma

**When Better Information Makes Agents Worse Off Under Endogenous Feasibility Constraints**

[SSRN 6478278](https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6478278) | [Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19251487](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19251487)

Blackwell's theorem (1953) states that more informative signals lead to weakly better decisions. This project studies the boundary created by irreversible actions, topology-blind signals, and the two-dimensional bond-percolation threshold $p_c = 1/2$.

## Installation

Python 3.9 or newer is required for the computational checks. Lean uses the
toolchain pinned in `lean4/lean-toolchain`.

```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
